program.pulse_sequence: Per physical batch: select/configure one TD; driver establish g; RESET all32 once; quench/rebias g; masked SET target1 once; return to read bias g; verify all32 in two new reads; commit transaction only after all8 planes pass.
program.verify_adc_timing: Main endpoint verify shares the named F_A parameter with normal evaluation only under explicit IM/clamp/gate/load and weakest-code settling qualification. One selected WL changes inactive branches relative to eight-WL q=0/1; separate thresholds address static offsets but do not prove equal settling. F_A includes input/reset; each pass pays it freshly, followed by TA and TD.
program.acceptance: Two calibrated endpoint classes: HRS below lower threshold, SET above upper threshold, with disjoint band and rail check; source |GRESET|<5 and GSET>50 ADC-count unit-cell distributions motivate separation only. New local thresholds are calibrated in the chosen SAR/voltage frontend, not copied as literal shared-ADC counts. No analog target-tuning or per-weight error guarantee.
program.normal_service_condition: One full RESET/SET schedule on characterized working cells reaches the two endpoint classes. Final verify is real time and rejects failures; a failed transaction produces no successful BR. No empirical batch yield, retry distribution, or worst-case bound is claimed; retry count is not silently folded into tau.
program.timing_ambiguity: PCM01 p7 SET 'width of250ns with trailing edge of50ns' does not disambiguate inclusion. Main conservatively uses300ns; total250ns variant recorded as sensitivity.
program.driver_bridge: 10/20/50ns each for current-source/switch settle, post-RESET quench/rebias, and post-SET return are explicit engineering budgets around ns-to-hundreds-ns PCM waveforms, not measured recovery or microsecond HV overhead. Main verify repeats the same F_A bias/front settle; optional weak-signal comparison alone repeats256ns precharge. Original32IDAC is retained as native source current-driver organization;700uA RESET needs22.4mA total;SET125uA needs4mA. Eight-plane routing and column-mode isolation andnativeWL are explicitly present.

normal_evaluation.qualification: F_A=10/20/50ns is an engineering reference budget, anchored only in the order of PCM-03 complete access; the replacement frontend has not been circuit-validated.

endpoint_verify.physical_operation: One selected WL and one cell per selected column, fresh reset/settle per pass, two-class endpoint check.
endpoint_verify.bias_load_endpoint: Same configured IM, clamp, selected-gate level and column/mux load as evaluation; inactive-branch changes need mode-specific threshold calibration and q=0/1 settling qualification.
endpoint_verify.qualification: Sharing F_A is a conditional design requirement, not measured equivalence; q=0/1 labels alone do not prove the eight-WL and one-WL paths settle equally.
endpoint_verify.source: PCM-03 PDF pp1-2 gives computation topology, not this single-cell verify; PCM-01 PDF pp4/8 gives endpoint separation and a different long-read implementation

long_observation_verify.qualification: The768ns minimum observation is a conservative operation quota inspired by a different measured analog verify. It does not bound shared F_A uncertainty; shared settling longer than the minimum extends verify as well as evaluation.
